spec.unit: concept-year y >= first attachment year + 1 (first year with frame-type c-papers in the snapshot)
spec.dominant: dom(y) = persistent id of the community holding the largest all-type tag weight (plural community); communities < 5 nodes have no persistent id (dom = -1)
spec.P: P_rar (m = 10, 50 draws, iteration-2 seeds); fallback P_raw if P_rar is NaN (flagged)

MIGRANT.rule: dom(y) != dom(y-1), both >= 0, AND dom(y) existed in y-1 (its persistent id is present at y-1)

BRIDGE.rule: P >= P_bridge OR >= 2 communities each holding >= share_bridge of the concept's all-type tag weight

CORE_GROWING.rule: wmz >= z_core AND size(dom, y) >= (1 + growth) * size(dom, y-1)

FOUNDER.rule: dom(y) was born (alluvial 'birth', no Jaccard >= 0.3 match in y-1) in [first_attach-1, first_attach+1] AND y - birth_year <= 1 AND the concept ranks in the top 5 of dom(y) by within-community strength (its frame-type tag weight into dom vs k_own of the community's members)

spec.robust: the modal primary role over the 5 NEW seeds (101-105) occurs in >= 3 of them
